title: Reverse a Number
statement:
Given a positive integer N, print its digits in reverse order as a number (without leading zeros).

For example, reversing 1230 gives 321 (not 0321).
inputFormat: A single line containing one positive integer N.
outputFormat: A single integer: N with its digits reversed, with no leading zeros.

examples.explanation: Reversing 1200 gives 0021, which as an integer is 21.
